feature_preprocessing: same float32 unit-normalized embeddings as other baselines; float64 linear algebra; no PCA or per-coordinate scaling
loss: sum of squared residuals plus alpha times squared weights; intercept unpenalized
selection: same alpha across candidate models, selected per outer split/encoder/lambda by pooled inner routing utility
implementation: Reuse source-centered eigendecomposition across alphas; fit reward/cost jointly with identical alpha then subtract lambda*cost. Exactly equivalent to utility-target ridge; no separate reward/cost tuning or prediction clipping.
protocol: Reuse frozen configs/baselines.json and configs/baseline_splits exactly
